nome_jp: 聖審絆官 シェムパザーレ
testo:
Sympathy Creature
Blocker
Triple Breaker
■ Whenever any of your creatures attacks, choose one of your opponent's creatures and tap it. That creature doesn't untap at the start of your opponent's next turn. (Choose what you are attacking before you choose the creature you tap.)
